specimen.annotation_note: This entry arrived by import, not by hand: the description was downloaded by robot_descriptions from Unitree's own repository and the facts above were parsed out of its URDF. Nothing here was gated — importing a description is not a verdict.
honesty: Gate status stays NOT_GATED: the motion gate grades wheeled ground robots, and no walking gate exists yet.
The parts kit stays undefined (kit: null in catalog/parts-kits.json): the kit generator builds wheeled kits from a spec's wheel block, and this robot has no wheels.

The entry's standing dimensions (0.70 x 0.31 x 0.40 m) come from Unitree's published parameter table, not from this URDF; the URDF's own zero-pose foot span (0.387 x 0.284 m) is a different measurement and neither replaces the other.
The URDF tree is not vendored into this repo — the manifest pins the upstream repo, commit and URDF path, and the license above was read from that repo's LICENSE file, not assumed.
